description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must finalize the pallet allocation and loading sequence for a Thursday resupply airlift to a forward logistics site, incorporating updates from operations, signal, and medical staff.

shared_context.S1: Thursday's contracted airlift has capacity for exactly 23 standard pallets.
shared_context.S2: The normal weekly request is 8 pallets of engineering materiel, 5 pallets of communications batteries, and 5 pallets of medical supplies.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez signs the final airlift manifest and loading instructions.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's routine weekly airlift-manifest review requires operations, signal, and medical staff to report any current changes to their standard pallet requests before the manifest is signed.
shared_context.S5: The three standard pallet requests total 18 pallets, leaving 5 unused spaces; all three increases can be accommodated if the revised requirements total no more than 23 pallets.

PF1.text: Capt. Morgan confirmed this morning that the engineering detachment's work order was moved ahead by the receiving site and now requires exactly 10 engineering pallets, two above the normal request; the revised work order has not yet been entered on the airlift manifest.

PF2.text: Lt. Okafor confirmed with the aircrew loadmaster that the communications battery shipment is now exactly 7 pallets, two above the normal request, and must be loaded first for the aircraft's pallet-restraint inspection; the loadmaster's update is not yet on the battalion briefing slide.

PF3.text: Capt. Sato confirmed that the receiving clinic's resupply order requires exactly 6 medical-supply pallets, one above the normal request, because the clinic's cold-storage replenishment was advanced to Thursday; the revised order is still being reconciled with the medical warehouse ledger.

acceptance_conditions: The manifest must allocate exactly 10 engineering pallets.
The manifest must allocate exactly 7 communications battery pallets.
The manifest must allocate exactly 6 medical-supply pallets.
The loading sequence must state that communications battery pallets are loaded first, followed by engineering pallets and then medical pallets.
The manifest total must be exactly 23 pallets.
A commitment to update the Thursday airlift manifest must be recorded.
The revised communications load requirement must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: 'communications battery pallets loaded first' in decisions['loading_sequence']

decisive_facts.why: The advanced engineering work order changes the engineering allocation from 8 to exactly 10 pallets and, together with the other revised requirements, makes the required manifest total exactly 23.

The loadmaster confirmation changes the communications allocation from 5 to exactly 7 pallets, requires the communications battery pallets to be loaded first, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The advanced clinic order changes the medical allocation from 5 to exactly 6 pallets and, together with the other revised requirements, makes the required manifest total exactly 23.
